creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A controlling client holds the pane's PTY at its geometry and never lets go: after the controller detaches the pane keeps that size rather than reverting (verified 53x23 -> 120x40 -> still 120x40, docs/observations/herdr-0.8.0.md section 4).

So quitting Muster leaves every pane it touched sized to a window that no longer exists, and the herdr TUI inherits that. This cuts against 'sessions outlive everything' - the fallback promise is that a rough Muster never costs a workday, and handing back mis-sized panes costs one.

Muster restores geometry on detach until herdr does it. Worth an upstream issue too: it looks like a defect rather than a design.
title: Restore pane geometry when Muster detaches
